title: Rigidity of stationary black holes with small ADM angular momentum
summary: We prove global rigidity of smooth asymptotically flat stationary vacuum black holes with sufficiently small ADM angular momentum, under global regularity, bifurcation, and maximal-hypersurface assumptions, with a threshold depending on fixed geometric bounds. This answers the question of Alexakis, Ionescu, and Klainerman concerning replacement of their smallness assumption on the stationary field at the bifurcation sphere by smallness of the angular momentum at infinity.
